body:
Cut from [Map: cc-otel production design](https://github.com/Gharib89/cc-otel/issues/1) via [Cut implementation issues from locked design](https://github.com/Gharib89/cc-otel/issues/13).

Implements: [Ingest reliability design](https://github.com/Gharib89/cc-otel/issues/7), [PII redaction policy](https://github.com/Gharib89/cc-otel/issues/8), parser mechanics from [Column-registry curation flow](https://github.com/Gharib89/cc-otel/issues/16), identity normalization from [Auth + identity model](https://github.com/Gharib89/cc-otel/issues/6), ADR-0003 (wrapper gauges), blob reservoir (ADR per docs/adr).

## Scope (`sink/`, FastAPI, Python 3.13)
- OTLP HTTP receiver endpoints; parser with **hard-coded promoted-column list** (matches the registry seed).
- Single redaction pass on decoded payload, post-parse pre-fan-out — both Postgres and blob receive redacted content. Denylist per #8: POC four (`full_command`, `bash_command`, `file_path`, `error`) + recursive `tool_parameters` sweep on `tool_result` **and** `tool_decision` + defense-in-depth strips (`prompt`, `response`, `body`, `body_ref`); keeps `tool_name`/all `*_name`/enums/`user.email`/numeric counts. Defense-in-depth strip of non-empty content increments a counter metric + warning log.
- `user.email` normalized (lowercase/trim), nullable — missing email ingests as null.
- Transactional Postgres write **before** the 200; 5xx on failure; batch-hash idempotency vs `meta.processed_batches` (hash computed on the **redacted** payload); retried batch = no-op 200.
- Blob redacted-raw write best-effort **after** the 200.
- Dockerfile; listens `localhost:8080` only (fronted by collector in the same Container App — no own ingress, per #6).

## Acceptance
- Unit tests green: redaction cases (incl. recursive sweep + strip-counter), email normalization, duplicate-batch no-op, failed-write 5xx.
- Image builds from `sink/`.
title: Sink service: OTLP parse, redaction pass, idempotent transactional writes, blob reservoir
